T1.name: auto_or_confirm
T1.meaning: Low-impact, reversible write. Run immediately and show a result card with Undo; workspace/user setting can force a confirm card.

T2.name: confirm
T2.meaning: Confirm card with resolved values (names + IDs, normalized dates) before execution. Required for anything that notifies/affects others, locks a subtree, transitions lifecycle state, or sends data out.

T3.name: typed_confirm
T3.meaning: Destructive or cascading. Cascade preview (counts) + user must type the entity name/key to proceed. Never batch-approved.

gateway_rules: workspace_id is injected by the gateway from the session; it is never a model argument and the model can never target another workspace.

Model-visible reference arguments (space_id, issue_id, assignee_id ...) accept names/keys; the gateway resolves them to canonical IDs, scoped to the active workspace and the caller's permissions, and echoes resolved values on the confirmation card.
Member resolution uses workspace_members_list only. user_list/user_get are excluded (platform-wide, cross-tenant).
Dates: parse with the user's profile date format and timezone, send ISO-8601, echo the normalized date. Durations are converted to duration_minutes.

Tier escalation: if the call was triggered while untrusted retrieved content (ticket text, comments, docs, attachments) is in context, raise the tier by one (T0 stays T0, T1->T2, T2->T3 only for destructive effects).
Loops: any tool executed more than once for one request is at least T2 with an item count preview; hard cap 100 items; stop after 3 consecutive failures; return per-item results.
Idempotency key per write (hash of conversation_id + step + resolved args) to prevent duplicate creates on retries.
Tool exposure per turn: send core tools + the 1-2 domains selected by the router (max ~25 tools). Never send all enabled tools to the model.
Role pre-check: if the caller's known workspace role cannot satisfy permission_required, refuse before calling the API.
API errors (403/404/409/423/400) are returned to the model verbatim, never retried blindly, and summarised plainly to the user.

tools.description: Link a GitHub repository to the workspace to enable auto-closing of issues via PR merges and commit refs. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.
tools.errors: - `400 Invalid repo format or already linked` - `403 Forbidden`

tools.exposure_reason: Inbound webhook endpoint (HMAC-signed by GitHub), not a user action.
tools.description: Receive and verify inbound GitHub webhook event payload (push, pull_request) to parse issue keys. Rules: Webhook signature must match configured repository secret.

payload.description: Event payload. GitHub webhook event JSON

tools.preconditions: Webhook signature must match configured repository secret.
tools.side_effects: Parses commits/PR descriptions for issue keys (e.g. 'Fixes ENG-104'); updates issue stage if merged; logs delivery.

tools.exposure_reason: Integration operations view.
tools.description: Inspect deferred or failed webhook delivery events for debugging sync delays. Rules: Caller must have System Admin or Workspace Admin rights.
tools.preconditions: Caller must have System Admin or Workspace Admin rights.

virtual_tools.description: Ask the user ONE consolidated clarification when required information is missing or a reference is ambiguous. Renders as chips/form. Prefer this over guessing.

options.description: Candidate answers, e.g. matching entity names.

fields.description: Optional form fields to collect several missing values at once.

virtual_tools.description: Find a project (Space) by name or key prefix in the active workspace. Returns candidates with id, name, key.
Find lists inside a space (optionally by name). Used to pick the target list for new tickets.
Find a sprint in a space by name, number or status (planned/active/completed).
Find workspace members by name or email. ONLY searches the active workspace (never the platform-wide user directory).
Find tickets by key (ENG-104) or by title text, optionally within a space.

Semantic + keyword search over ticket text, comments, documentation and help content the user may access. Use for "which tickets mention...", "how do I...", "what did we decide about...". Do NOT use for counts/filters/sums: use list/report tools. Returns passages with citations.
Clone a ticket (title, description, type, priority, points) into a list and link it with relationship "clones". Subtasks and labels are not modeled and are not copied.

virtual_tools.closes_gap: GAP-02 (until a native bulk endpoint exists)
virtual_tools.description: Apply the same change to many tickets, selected by explicit keys or a filter. ALWAYS dry-run first and show count + sample; executes sequentially with per-item results; stops after 3 consecutive failures.

filter.description: space, sprint, status, priority, type, assignee, search

changes.description: Fields to set (status, priority, assignee_id, due_date, story_points) or {"delete": true}.
